name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, serves static site content, creates development certificates, and applies host and web-server security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including authenticated Redis listening, Fedora PID and log directories, and Redis service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment and dependencies, creates its database and user, and runs Uvicorn through systemd.
